title: Final Summary: SurrealDB Official Library Integration

instructionalToFunctionalBridge.instructionalRequirement: Replace buggy custom HTTP RPC client with official surrealdb-py library (>=1.0.0) to fix variant_id and activity_id persistence issue in template_metrics
instructionalToFunctionalBridge.rootCauseDiagnosed: Custom HTTP client had parameter serialization bugs in _execute_rpc() causing RecordID types to be handled incorrectly. Using db.update() replaces ALL fields, so missing fields become NONE.

lessonsLearned.detail: The custom HTTP RPC client was created to work around auth bugs in surrealdb-py v1.0.8 with SurrealDB v2.3.10. But it introduced NEW bugs (parameter serialization). Upgrading both to compatible versions is better than workarounds.

lessonsLearned.lesson: update() vs merge() semantic difference is critical
lessonsLearned.detail: SurrealDB's update() replaces ALL fields. merge() does partial updates. Using update() without explicit field preservation causes data loss. This was the root cause.
Making get_surreal_client() async requires ALL callers to be async. This ripples through 15-20 files. Should have done complete async conversion upfront.
Phase 1 (client rewrite) can be validated independently. Phase 2 (async conversion) is mechanical and testable. Phase 3 (deployment) is infrastructure.
